meta.title: OSIDAC — Own a business that runs 24/7 from your phone
meta.description: OSIDAC is a virtual franchise & rewards platform. Buy a digital franchise package, earn from your store, paid missions and your network, then withdraw to e-wallet or bank.

hero.title: Own a business that runs 24/7 — right from your phone.
hero.subtitle: OSIDAC turns your phone into a little business: claim daily store revenue, complete paid missions, grow your branches, and cash out to e-wallet or bank. No crypto. No empty promises.
hero.stat3: Payouts funded by real ad & game budgets

how.title: Simple: Buy → Get → Withdraw
how.subtitle: Every coin in your wallet comes from real revenue — advertiser budgets, game studio budgets and package margin. Never from other members' money.
how.buyText: Get a Digital Franchise package (from $3.49) with real value: store level-up, earning multipliers, vouchers and merch.
how.getText: Your store produces coins around the clock. Add paid missions, playtime games and team bonuses to earn more.
how.wdText: Convert coins to cash and withdraw to e-wallet or bank — fast, with a low minimum threshold.

packages.title: Franchise packages
packages.subtitle: The package price already pays for itself through vouchers, merch and multipliers. Any coins you earn are a bonus — never a promised return.

earn.title: Four real earning engines
earn.subtitle: OSIDAC pays you from revenue it actually earns. Here is where the money comes from.
earn.storeText: Claim your store's coins every 8 hours. Rate follows real revenue — published transparently.
earn.missionText: Install apps, reach game levels, complete surveys. Advertisers pay — you keep 60–70%.
earn.playText: Play partner games and earn per minute & milestone, funded by game studios.
earn.teamText: Build branches and earn from package margin and mission margin share — capped and sustainable.

network.title: Build branches, earn together
network.subtitle: Invite friends to open their own stores. You earn 3 levels deep from real margins — your team keeps 100% of what they earn.
network.note: Total network payouts are hard-capped at 40%. Free members can earn too — buying a package is never required to join.

transparency.title: How we can pay you (no secrets)
transparency.subtitle: Every month we publish our revenue sources and distribution ratio. When revenue dips, rates dip — we never pay old members with new members' money.
transparency.formula: Distribution to members ≤ 70% of actual revenue (ads + playtime + missions + package margin)
transparency.disclaimer: OSIDAC is a rewards platform, not an investment. Earnings are not guaranteed and depend on your activity. No crypto is involved.

footer.legal: OSIDAC is not an investment product. There are no fixed returns. Purchases are digital franchise products with real benefits (vouchers, merch, multipliers).
